scripts.test:unit: bun test packages/*/test/*.test.ts examples/*/test/*.test.ts examples/*/tutorial/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit:coverage: bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage/unit packages/*/test/*.test.ts examples/*/test/*.test.ts examples/*/tutorial/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:unit:coverage && bun run test:integration:coverage && bun run coverage:merge && bun run coverage:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd examples/course-enrolment-ui typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/processors-admin-ui typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/chaos-ui typecheck
